description: This file defines the 'Template' class in the Opencart system, responsible for managing and rendering templates through adaptor classes.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class that manages template rendering via different adaptors, enabling dynamic loading and rendering of templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template object with a specified adaptor class, throwing an exception if the class does not exist.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Delegates the addition of a path to the adaptor object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Delegates rendering of a template to the adaptor object, passing filename, data, and optional code.
